overloads.semanticRole: Converts a system-syntax pathname (Windows or Mac OS, relative or absolute) to an absolute POSIX-syntax pathname.

constraints: systemPath may be relative to the database folder or absolute; a relative path is completed against the database folder in the returned value. The command always returns an absolute POSIX pathname.
The command does not verify that the path exists on disk.
The '*' literal-symbol parameter requests percent-encoding of special characters in the returned POSIX path (e.g. "My folder" -> "My%20folder"); by default (omitted), the output is not encoded.
